{
  "subtype": "focus_inference",
  "implied_focus": "Characterizing IT asset/procurement expenses by what was purchased and the data-quality/provenance of each record",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "asset_category", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Directly typologizes the purchased asset (hardware/cloud/software/travel), a core facet of what the expense is for."},
    {"name": "asset_brand", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Vendor/brand dimension of the asset, a coherent attribute for spend analysis."},
    {"name": "travel_related", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Flags a distinct spend category; complements asset_category, mild redundancy with travel_equipment."},
    {"name": "procurement_action_type", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Classifies the procurement lifecycle action, a meaningful facet of expense type."},
    {"name": "entry_origin", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Provenance/data-quality facet (manual vs auto), useful for judging record reliability."},
    {"name": "has_source_id", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Data-completeness flag; supports the data-quality sub-theme but is somewhat mechanical."},
    {"name": "ci_identifier_quality", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Assesses quality of the CI identifier, a genuine actionable data-quality dimension."},
    {"name": "repeat_user_flag", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Behavioral flag tied to users; loosely related but drifts from the asset/data-quality core (near-constant at 486/14)."}
  ],
  "focus_coherence": 0.72,
  "structure_quality": 0.7,
  "focus_actionability": 0.75,
  "rationale": "The columns cluster around two related but distinguishable themes: (1) what the expense purchased (asset_category, asset_brand, travel_related, procurement_action_type) and (2) the quality/provenance of the record (entry_origin, has_source_id, ci_identifier_quality). Together they cohere reasonably around 'understanding and enriching IT asset/procurement expense records', giving decent but not tight focus_coherence. The structure is genuinely analytical -- categorical enrichments with useful granularity rather than restatements or token-count noise, and the data-quality facets are directly actionable (fix generic placeholders, review manual entries). Weaknesses: travel_related duplicates a value already inside asset_category, and repeat_user_flag is near-constant (486/14) and thematically peripheral, slightly diluting the single-focus claim. Overall a coherent, actionable inference, not a scattered grab-bag."
}
